message.content:
The value of a U.S. dollar against the British pound fluctuates daily based on market conditions. As of the most recent exchange rates (mid‑day 2026‑06‑01), 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So roughly **£15.60** would be the equivalent of $20 at that moment.

> **Note:** Exchange rates change constantly. For an exact amount at the time of your transaction, check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
